india6.description: In a speech that outlined the road ahead for the INDIA bloc, the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha asserted Congress’s primacy, acknowledged constraints, and urged unity amid sharp internal differences

india6.title: CITU urges Haryana to extend deadline, publish Labour Code Rules in Hindi
Regional parties should rejoin Congress, strengthen Opposition unity: Ashok Gehlot
india6.description: The former Chief Minister said safeguarding democratic values should be the foremost priority for all political forces, as the democracy in the country was “under serious threat”

india6.title: Signature of rebels Trinamool MPs in public, many actor turned Parliamentarians switch sides
india6.description: A majority of the rebel Trinamool Congress MPs are first time Parliamentarian, including cricketer turned politician Yusuf Pathan, actor Saayoni Ghosh and Cooch Behar MP Jagadish Verma Basunia among others

india6.title: Murari Babu, former TDB official accused in Sabarimala gold theft case, passes away
india6.description: Murari Babu has been ailing for some time, and the death occurred around 12.48 a.m., said authorities of the Amrita Hospital in Kochi

india6.title: ‘Deep-seated’ bias for male child persists despite improving sex ratio, says Supreme Court
india6.description: The top court refused to quash criminal proceedings against a Maharashtra doctor under the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act, 1994

india6.title: Supported by CJP, Lucknow students protest lack of transparency, irregularities in recruitment drives
india6.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke joins protest; protesters demand independent high-level inquiry into Lekhpal exam irregularities, seek permanent grievance redressal mechanism for competitive exam aspirants

india6.title: Punjab may go to polls in November, Mann to return as CM: Kejriwal
india6.description: “I have been told that the elections will be held in November [2026], not February [2027]. Only four months are left. Now we all have only one task — to make Bhagwant Singh Mann Chief Minister again,” said the ruling party’s national convener.

india6.title: Maharashtra to table ‘Women Farmers Empowerment Bill’ during upcoming Monsoon Session
india6.description: Mr. Fadnavis reviewed a preliminary presentation on the draft Bill at a meeting attended by Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Ajit Pawar, Agriculture Minister Dattatray Bharane and Minister of State for Agriculture Ashish Jaiswal at his official residence on Friday

india6.title: Odisha CM announces free education from KG to PG in govt. institutions
india6.description: The State launches Chief Minister Annapurna Yojana, under which all beneficiaries of the National Food Security Act and State Food Security Scheme will receive, an additional 5 kg of rice per month free of cost

india6.title: No formal proposal yet, say senior NCP(SP) leaders amid buzz over merger with Congress
india6.description: While the Congress’s Maharashtra unit has refused comment on speculations about the merger, sources said a proposal to this effect has been in the pipeline for some time.

india6.title: ED arrests two former executives of Reliance Anil Ambani Group
india6.description: The ED has taken transit remand of Sateesh Seth and Gautam Doshi, both of whom previously served as directors of Reliance Telecom Ltd., and is taking them to Delhi as the case is registered in the national capital, they said.

india6.title: Will bring Tatas to Bengal but land at Singur no longer belongs to govt., says Bengal CM
india6.description: The Chief Minister who has been in office for about five weeks says that benefits of the double-engine government are slowly reaching the people of West Bengal

india6.title: Road, drainage works progressing along Palarivattom corridor
india6.description: The laying of interlocking tiles has been completed over a short stretch in front of St. Martin’s Church at Palarivattom, while groundwork, including the spreading of metal and surface levelling, is under way

india6.title: Invisible tropical waves linked to extreme rainfall, says study
india6.description: The study reveals that invisible atmospheric disturbances known as Kelvin, Rossby and Mixed Rossby-Gravity waves significantly enhance heavy rainfall by organising deep convective cloud systems and increasing moisture convergence over the Arabian Sea and the Western Ghats

india6.title: Police propose measures to tackle Kochi city’s traffic woes on a war footing
india6.description: Identified traffic choke points include Edappally, Palarivattom, Cheranalloor, Edachira, Vyttila, Thiruvankulam, Thevara, Bolgatty Junction, Pallimukku, High Court Jn., Kaloor and Kadavanthra

india6.title: High Court directs panel to proceed with demolition of Chander Kunj Army towers
india6.description: Firm that demolished Maradu flats gets nod for twin towers’ demolition; court declines to stay award of demolition contract to Edifice Engineering despite challenge by lowest bidder

india6.title: Malayidamthuruth land dispute talks hit hurdle
india6.description: Minister-led meeting scheduled to discuss a proposal to avoid the eviction of seven Dalit families from the 2.69-acre Pariyathukavu settlement postponed to a later date

india7.title: Donald Trump accuses Iran of attacking Indian ships; Tehran rejects charge
india7.description: US President Trump accused Iran of drone attacks on Indian ships near Hormuz, calling it ‘unacceptable’. Iran denied this, labelling the claim 'baseless' and accusing the US of attacking the vessels.

india7.title: US team ease to 4-1 victory over Paraguay
india7.description: Folarin Balogun scored twice as the USA convincingly beat Paraguay 4-1 in their opening Group D match.

india7.title: Supreme Court sets value of wife's domestic care at ₹30,000, calls homemakers 'Nation Builders'
india7.description: The Supreme Court ruled homemakers are 'nation builders', setting a minimum £30,000 monthly compensation for a wife's loss of domestic care in accident cases, acknowledging their vital, unpaid contribution.

india7.title: Supreme Court rejects Meenakshi Natarajan's plea against RS nomination rejection
india7.description: Congress decried the rejection of its Rajya Sabha nominee, calling it a 'theft' and 'betrayal' of democracy after BJP candidates were elected unopposed.

india7.title: Exploring the best refer and earn apps in India
india7.description: Refer and earn programs offer a practical way to earn extra income by recommending platforms, requiring no experience or capital. Financial product referrals often yield higher payouts, with earnings based on successful actions and paid directly.

india7.title: Trump suspends Iran strikes, says deal nearly complete; Tehran unconvinced
india7.description: President Trump stated a deal to end the war with Iran is nearly complete, with Iran agreeing not to acquire nuclear weapons and the Strait of Hormuz reopening.

india7.title: Three Indian sailors killed in US strike off Oman
india7.description: Three Indian sailors died during a US operation off Oman to intercept a tanker, with India lodging a strong protest.

india7.title: Gold prices continue to fall in Kerala, down ₹5,520 per sovereign in two days
india7.description: Gold prices in Kerala dropped significantly, following international trends and US Federal Reserve interest rate expectations. This offers relief to buyers after a previous surge.

india7.title: Kuwait closes airspace amid ongoing Iranian attacks
india7.description: The announcement was made by Kuwait's Directorate General of Civil Aviation, which said flights were being diverted to alternative airports.

india7.title: Iran announces closure of  Strait of Hormuz after fresh US strikes, threatens to attack ships
india7.description: The US conducted strikes in Iran, threatening more if no peace deal is reached. Iran claimed counter-attacks and warned of Strait of Hormuz action, while US denied a closure and denied significant damage from Iranian strikes.

japan1.title: 「スペースX」が上場 調達資金 約12兆円は過去最大規模
japan1.description: アメリカの実業家、イーロン・マスク氏が率い、宇宙開発やAI事業を手がける「スペースX」は12日、ニューヨークのナスダック市場に上場しました。上場による調達額はおよそ750億ドル、日本円にしておよそ12兆円と過去最大の規模となります。

japan1.title: ウリ信用組合に一部業務停止命令 顧客の預金着服などで 金融庁
japan1.description: 金融庁は、札幌市のウリ信用組合に対して、元役員が顧客の預金を着服するなど複数の不祥事が起きていたにもかかわらず、長期間にわたり経営陣の主導で隠蔽していたなどとして、12日、新規顧客への貸し付けなど一部業務の停止命令を出しました。

japan1.title: 大手航空2社 燃油サーチャージ再度引き上げ 燃料価格高騰で
japan1.description: 全日空と日本航空は、国際線の運賃に上乗せする燃油サーチャージについて、7月の発券分から引き上げると発表しました。5月と6月の発券分も引き上げていましたが、燃料の高騰が続いていることを受けての対応だとしています。

japan1.title: Booking.comの予約客に不審なメッセージ相次ぐ 注意呼びかけ
japan1.description: 日本ホテル協会は、宿泊予約サイト「Booking.com」を通じてホテルを予約した客に、クレジットカードの情報を入力させようとする不審なメッセージが届く事例が相次いでいるとして、注意を呼びかけています。

japan1.title: 円相場 小幅な値動き 1ドル＝160円台前半での取り引き
japan1.description: 12日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は小幅な値動きとなり、1ドル＝160円台前半での取り引きが続きました。

japan1.title: スーパーのコメ平均価格 5キロ 税込み3644円 3週連続値下がり
japan1.description: 全国のスーパーで6月7日までの1週間に販売されたコメの平均価格は、5キロ当たり税込み3644円と前の週より29円下がりました。値下がりは3週連続で、銘柄米の下げ幅が大きくなっています。

japan1.title: 生命保険の営業職員 新たな呼び名は「ソナエルジュ」に
japan1.description: 家庭や職場を訪れて保険を販売し、生保レディーとも呼ばれた営業職員について、生命保険協会は、新たな呼び名を「ソナエルジュ」にすると発表しました。性別にとらわれず、顧客に寄り添うという仕事内容が表現されているとしています。

japan1.title: 自民対策本部 南米EPA交渉なら“農業に配慮を”政府に申し入れ
japan1.description: 南米の関税同盟「メルコスール」と日本との間のEPA＝経済連携協定について、自民党の対策本部は仮に交渉を始める場合、国内農業への影響を避けるため、牛肉をはじめとした重要な品目に十分配慮することなどを政府に申し入れました。

japan1.title: 株価 一時2800円超上昇 イランへの攻撃中止表明受け
japan1.description: 12日の東京株式市場、アメリカのトランプ大統領がイランへの攻撃を中止したと明らかにしたことなどを受けて、日経平均株価の上昇幅は一時、2800円を超えました。

japan1.title: 東京株式市場 キオクシアHDの時価総額が国内首位に
japan1.description: 12日の東京株式市場で、半導体・フラッシュメモリの世界大手、キオクシアホールディングスの株価が上昇し、時価総額がトヨタ自動車を上回って国内首位になりました。

japan1.title: “来月 原油代替調達で去年並み確保も対策進める”経産相
japan1.description: ホルムズ海峡を経由しない代替ルートでの原油の調達で来月は中東情勢が悪化する前の去年とほぼ同じ量を確保できる見込みとなったことについて、赤澤経済産業大臣は12日の閣議のあとの会見で、必要な量の確保など原油の安定供給に向けた対策を引き続き進めていく考えを示しました。

japan1.title: 改正郵便法が成立 郵便料金を柔軟に変更可能に 値上げも検討
japan1.description: 日本郵便で郵便事業の赤字が続いていることを受けて、料金を総務大臣の認可によって改定できるようにする郵便法の改正案が、12日開かれた参議院本会議で可決・成立しました。

bang3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bang3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bang3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bang3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bang3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bang3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bang3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bang3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bang3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bang3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bang3.title: Road crash claims six more lives
bang3.description: A toddler, her mother, and aunt were among six people who died after a bus rammed into an auto-rickshaw in Bakerganj, Barishal, yesterday afternoon.

bang3.title: Rajapaksa ally elected Lanka president
bang3.description: Six-time prime minister Ranil Wickremesinghe was elected as crisis-wracked Sri Lanka’s new president by the country’s parliament yesterday, with the backing of the party of the ex-leader -- who fled abroad after his palace was stormed by protesters.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’

bd3.title: Rajapaksa ally elected Lanka president
bd3.description: Six-time prime minister Ranil Wickremesinghe was elected as crisis-wracked Sri Lanka’s new president by the country’s parliament yesterday, with the backing of the party of the ex-leader -- who fled abroad after his palace was stormed by protesters.

ca3.description: Violent, nihilistic extremism targeting kids online is an "escalating threat" across Canada and the world, Winnipeg police say, and they're urging parents and caregivers to learn the warning signs so they can step in before it's too late.

ca3.title: B.C. birth alerts class-action lawsuit leads to $66M proposed settlement
ca3.description: A class-action lawsuit filed on behalf of people who were the subject of birth alerts, which shared private information without the person's knowledge, has reached a $66-million proposed settlement, according to class counsel.

ca3.title: 4 grizzly bears killed by hunters through Alberta's 'problem wildlife' program so far
ca3.description: Four grizzly bears have been killed by authorized hunters since the Alberta government introduced the Wildlife Management Responder Network in June 2024. The most recent lethal grizzly removal happened on June 8, south of Pincher Creek, where the province says a grizzly bear killed several cattle.

ca3.title: What happens to mortgages, banking if Alberta were to separate?
ca3.description: The group pushing for separation says mortgages would carry over, and Canada's big banks would seek to operate in an independent Alberta. But analysts say there are a lot of unknowns, and the process would likely be very complicated.

ca3.title: In Alberta, competitive handgun shooters feel targeted by Ottawa's gun ban
ca3.description: The International Practical Shooting Confederation has about 6,000 Canadian members — but with no way for most people to legally acquire handguns, competitive shooters fear their sport’s days are numbered.

ca3.title: OPP Const. Tarun Bali's body brought to Thornhill, Ont., ahead of funeral
ca3.description: Bali, 29, was struck by the driver of a vehicle on Tuesday in the northern town of Hearst, about 520 kilometres east of Thunder Bay, as fellow investigators searched for a man who had escaped from a hospital.

ca3.title: Protect young people from social media harms 'without silencing them,' says Hamilton teen content creator
ca3.description: A teen content creator who has spent years promoting books to kids online says the Canadian government should focus on how to better protect young people from the harms of social media, before imposing an outright ban.

ca3.title: ‘There's no peace’ says mother left grieving after sentencing delay for fatal 2023 crash
ca3.description: Family and friends of Mark Squires squeezed into a small provincial court room in St. John's on Thursday, hoping the man responsible for the death of their loved one would be sentenced to prison.

ca3.title: Bear wandering around with pipe stuck on head rescued by conservation officers
ca3.description: The B.C. Conservation Service is not sure how the yearling got its head stuck in a stove pipe, but adds it is an important reminder to call the service if you see an animal in distress.

ca3.title: Imperial Oil fined $120K for wastewater spill at oilsands site north of Fort McMurray
ca3.description: Court documents say the spill occurred because sensors designed to detect an increase in liquids at a storage pond did not account for sediment that had accumulated in recent years.

ca3.title: As World Cup boosts infection risk, Toronto and Vancouver aren't sitting on the sidelines
ca3.description: Public health officials in Canada, the U.S. and Mexico prepare for an influx of measles cases and food-borne illnesses on top of heat events ahead of the FIFA World Cup.

ca3.title: Man sentenced in shooting at B.C. home of AP Dhillon says Bishnoi gang is threatening to kill him

ca3.title: Canada Post announces 485,000 more addresses to lose home delivery

ca3.title: B.C. court to allow Rossland magnesium mine to proceed without environmental assessment
ca3.description: The Record Ridge mine near Rossland, B.C., is set to go ahead without an environmental assessment certificate, with a B.C. Supreme Court judge rejecting a lawsuit calling for more scrutiny filed by local residents.

ca3.title: Manitoba premier announces provincewide disaster financial assistance program for flood damage
